rules.sleeves: ceil(holding / spacing) equal sleeves; signal date T uses sleeve ((T - first signal) / spacing) mod n; sleeves do not rebalance each other
rules.entry: T+1 open for every scored signal whose name has a bar at T+1, including signals whose holding runs past the data end (evaluate no_label): the order state is separate from the label state and there is no stop-entry date
rules.exit: T+holding close; missing bar -> first close within evaluate.EXIT_LAG_SESSIONS
rules.open_at_end: a position still open on the last session is marked at its last available close; end values report the open positions, the unlabelled ones, those whose last bar is not the final session, the invested sleeves and the cash share
rules.late_exit_cash: a sale after the sleeve's next entry leaves its proceeds idle until the following entry
rules.splits: shares x split_to/split_from and the carried mark x split_from/split_to, once per execution date after the entry session (the entry open is already post-split), so a split on a day without a bar keeps the value and the next bar is used as quoted; a censored position keeps its shares from its first missing bar on; across a rename the old ticker's splits count up to its last bar and the successor's from that bar on (the window evaluate._renamed uses), so a split filed under the successor on a gap day is applied at the switch and a reused symbol inherits nothing
rules.passive_spy: SPY bought at the first entry open and held to the ledger's end, no costs, no idle cash: the investor's alternative, reported next to the same-rule SPY sleeves

censored.legacy: scenario: flat at the last observed close, settled at the planned exit
censored.zero: scenario: last observed close moving with SPY, settled at the planned exit
censored.loss: scenario: worthless from the first missing bar

rules.scenarios: legacy, zero and loss are sensitivity scenarios, not verified bounds: the last close is no guaranteed ceiling for merger or delisting proceeds, and zero need not lie between the other two
rules.returns: price_only: raw opens and closes for the lists and for SPY, no dividends on either side
rules.costs: per side, basis points of traded notional, at entry and exit
rules.benchmark: SPY bought in every slot under the same sleeve, entry, exit and cost rules
rules.ledger_weekly: one sleeve, buy T+1 open, sell T+5 close, rebuy T+6 open, flat overnight

observation_rules.primary: sum(observable excess) / (observable + pre-decided empty slots); unobservable names removed

bounds.legacy: censored at the last observed close over the shortened window (pre-fix behaviour)
bounds.zero: censored at zero excess, kept in the denominator
bounds.loss: censored as a total loss (return -1) against SPY over the full window
